about: The owner-confirmation card's two new lines of sight: the "If you confirm" block right above
Confirm done, and the folded "What counts as done" row with its item count. One set of cases both
clients are proved against: the web reads this file in `OwnerConfirmationCard.test.tsx`
the Mac and the phone cannot say two different things about one confirmation.
`rows`: `ifConfirmed` as `GET /tasks/:taskId/owner-confirmation` publishes it (an item the server
could not read is absent) → the rows the block draws, in order. `kind` picks the row's symbol;
`lead` is its first line; `added` is the branch's added lines, drawn after ` · ` in the diff's
green; `detail` is the quieter second line. No rows → no block at all.
`criteria`: a task's acceptance criteria (Markdown) → the count the folded row says. Top-level
list items are counted when there are any, paragraphs otherwise; nothing written → null, and the
box says nobody wrote it down instead of folding.
